name: High-roof cargo van (Ford Transit 250 class)
note: Specs: Penske high-roof cargo van (up to 9,000 lb GVW, 3,500 lb payload, 404 cu ft; Penske cargo-vans FAQ: 'average 12 mpg'). pallet_positions derived: 11'11" x 4'6" cargo floor = 3 x 48x40 pallets. cost_per_mile_ex_driver = gasoline $4.354/12 mpg + 0.1104 maintenance+repair+tires (AAA 2025 all-vehicle avg, consumer duty so likely low). fixed_cost_per_day = (median new 2026 Transit 250 cargo van price $52,074 / 60 mo straight-line, no interest, = $868.0/mo x12 + insurance $2,268/yr MoneyGeek van avg) / 250 operating days (assumption: 5 d x 50 wk) = $12,684/yr. Fuel = EIA US regular gasoline week of 2026-10-05.
source_name: Penske Truck Rental high-roof cargo van spec page; EIA; AAA Your Driving Costs 2025; Comvoy new listings; MoneyGeek

name: 16 ft box truck (Ford E-350 cutaway class, gasoline)
note: Specs: Penske 16 ft box truck (up to 12,500 lb GVW, 4,300 lb payload, 800 cu ft; 'two rows of approximately four pallets' = 8 floor positions; ramp, not liftgate). mpg 9.6 derived = midpoint of Penske 'up to 12 mpg' and AFDC delivery-truck 7.2 mpg-GGE. cost_per_mile_ex_driver = gasoline $4.354/9.6 + 0.11 M&R (ANL/Utilimarc medium-duty van year-1 range 0.07-0.15 midpoint; tires assumed inside M&R). fixed_cost_per_day = (median of 30 new 2026 E-350 box vans on Comvoy $59,749 / 60 mo = $996.0/mo x12 + insurance $5,100/yr midpoint of FreightWaves 16 ft range $3,000-7,200) / 250 days = $17,052/yr.
source_name: Penske Truck Rental 16 ft box truck spec page; AFDC; ANL TCO 2021; Comvoy; FreightWaves Checkpoint

name: 26 ft box truck, non-CDL (class 6 diesel, liftgate)
cdl_required: no (26,000 lb GVWR; CDL starts at 26,001)
note: Specs: Penske 22-26 ft box truck non-CDL (up to 26,000 lb GVW, 10,000 lb payload, 1,700 cu ft, liftgate up to 3,000 lb; CDL version 33,000 GVW / 17,000 lb). pallet_positions derived: interior 25'11" x 8'1" = 6 rows x 2 of 48x40 straight (14 if turned). mpg derived = AFDC delivery truck 7.2 mpg-GGE x 1.12 GGE per diesel gal (AFDC fuel properties) = 8.06; Penske prints 'up to 13 mpg'. cost_per_mile_ex_driver = diesel $6.199/8.06 + 0.425 M&R (ANL/Utilimarc box-truck year-1 range 0.35-0.50 midpoint; utility-fleet low-VMT data, likely high for delivery). fixed_cost_per_day = (median of 31 new 2026 class-6 dry box trucks on Comvoy $119,595 / 60 mo = $1993.0/mo x12 + insurance $9,900 midpoint FreightWaves 26 ft $6,600-13,200) / 250 days = $33,816/yr.
source_name: Penske Truck Rental 22-26 ft box truck spec page; AFDC; ANL TCO 2021; Comvoy; FreightWaves Checkpoint; EIA

name: 24-26 ft straight flatbed, non-CDL (class 6 diesel)
cdl_required: no (26,000 lb GVWR); CDL variant 33,000 GVW / 18,000 lb payload is common in building supply
note: Specs: Penske 24-26 ft flatbed non-CDL (up to 26,000 lb GVW, 10,000 lb payload, liftgate up to 3,000 lb). cube 0 = open deck. pallet_positions derived: 24 ft deck = 6 rows x 2. mpg and M&R as box_26. fixed_cost_per_day = (median of 18 new 2026 class-6 flatbeds on Comvoy $101,358 / 60 mo = $1689.0/mo x12 + insurance $9,900 (FreightWaves 26 ft box range used as proxy)) / 250 days = $30,168/yr.
source_name: Penske Truck Rental 24-26 ft flatbed spec page; AFDC; ANL TCO 2021; Comvoy; FreightWaves Checkpoint; EIA

name: Tractor + 53 ft dry van
cdl_required: yes (Class A: GCWR over 26,001 with trailer over 10,000)
note: gvwr_lb = 80,000 gross combined weight (Penske tandem-axle day cab). Trailer: Hale Trailer 53 ft dry van ~3,800-4,000 cu ft usable, 26 pallets single stack, ~44,000 lb common max payload. cost_per_mile_ex_driver = diesel $6.199/7.06 mpg + ATRI 2025 R&M $0.215 + tires $0.05 = 1.143 (tolls $0.043 excluded). mpg derived = AFDC Class 8 6.3 mpg-GGE x 1.12 = 7.06; ATRI-implied 7.6 (2025 EIA avg diesel $3.662 / ATRI fuel $0.482/mi). fixed_cost_per_day = ATRI 2025 per-mile x 85,991 mi/yr (ATRI avg annual miles): truck $0.28 ($2006.0/mo) + trailer $0.12 ($860.0/mo) + insurance $0.106 ($9,115.0/yr) + permits $0.008 ($688.0/yr) = $44,195/yr / 250 days.
source_name: Hale Trailer dry van guide; Penske tandem-axle day cab page; ATRI Operational Costs 2026 Update via FleetOwner; AFDC; EIA
